title: Add currency dialog (TAVI) vs Edit currency dialog (Zoho CRM)
label: GAPS vs ZOHO
env: TAVI: ndc-crm.anyware.software › Settings › Company Settings › Currencies (Add currency) | Zoho: crm.zoho.com › Setup › Company Settings › Currencies (Edit US Dollar). Note: the Zoho screenshot is the Edit dialog, not Add.

panels.caption: Zoho CRM — Edit US Dollar - USD

rows: Choose the currency
Currency is shown in the dialog title (Edit US Dollar - USD); picked from Zoho's currency list when adding.
Currency picker (Euro) — picked from a list.
SAME
Currency symbol
Code/Symbol is a dropdown: show the ISO code (USD) or the symbol ($).
Symbol is a free-text box (€). No choice between code and symbol; any text can be typed.
GAP
Exchange rate
Update Type: Automatic or Manual. Manual rate typed in a box with the currency code prefix (USD | 15.65).
One manual rate box only ("How many AED one EUR is worth"). No Automatic update option. Save stays disabled until a rate is typed.
GAP
Active / inactive
Status toggle per currency in the list (All Status filter).
"Active (can be chosen for records)" checkbox in the dialog; power button per row in the list.
SAME
Number format
Format section: Symbol Position (Before/After value), Digit Separators (1,234,567 etc.), Decimal Places (0–n), and a live Preview (USD 1,234,567).
No Format section at all: no symbol position, no digit separators, no decimal places, no preview.
GAP
Currencies list
Columns: Currency (link), Format (ILS 1,234,567), Update Type (Manual), Exchange Rate with info icon, Last Modified By + date, Status toggle; search box above the list.
Columns: Currency, Symbol, Exchange rate (1 USD = 50 AED), Status text, edit / activate / delete icons. No Format, Update Type or Last Modified By columns; no search.
GAP
